caption: Search strategy: facets, terms and equivalent strings for OpenAlex (primary retrieval), Google Scholar and Dimensions (recall benchmarking).
head: Facet / system
Search terms and syntax
Notes
rows: F1 Ecosystem services
“ecosystem service*” OR “ecological service*” OR “environmental service*” OR “nature contributions to people” OR “natural capital”
Title, abstract and OpenAlex keywords
F2 Spatially explicit modelling

“spatially explicit” OR spatial* OR spatiotemporal OR mapping OR map* OR GIS OR “remote sensing” OR satellite OR InVEST OR ARIES OR SWAT OR RUSLE OR “CA-Markov” OR FLUS OR “PLUS model” OR “Google Earth Engine” OR Landsat OR MODIS OR Sentinel OR “machine learning” OR “random forest” OR scenario* OR simulat* OR raster OR pixel OR geospatial OR hotspot*
Names of models and sensors broaden recall of applied studies
F3 Climate & environmental change

“climate change” OR “climate variab*” OR warming OR drought OR “land use change” OR “land cover change” OR urbani?ation OR deforestation OR degradation OR desertification OR “environmental change” OR “global change” OR “landscape change”
Captures both climatic and land-system drivers
F4 Global South
Author affiliation flagged Global South by OpenAlex OR title/abstract mention of Africa*, Asia*, Latin America*, Caribbean, Middle East, “developing countr*” and 80 country or landscape names
Study-area clause captures externally led research
Filters
Publication years 1990–2025; type = article or review; then screening (Table 2)
OQL query archived in the Supplementary material
Google Scholar (benchmark)
“ecosystem services” (InVEST OR mapping OR model) (“climate change” OR “land use change”) (Africa OR Asia OR “Latin America” OR “Global South”); custom range 1990–2025; patents and citations excluded
Run as several country-specific strings to respect the 256-character limit
Dimensions (benchmark)

Title and abstract: F1 AND F2 AND F3 AND F4 (same terms); Publication type = Article; Years 1990–2025; Fields of Research 2020: 41 Environmental Sciences, 37 Earth Sciences, 30 Agricultural, Veterinary and Food Sciences
Used for recall benchmarking and grant linkage checks
